title: Viral Pesto & Crumbled Feta Fried Eggs on Avocado Toast
ingredients: 1/2 ripe Hass avocado, mashed with lemon juice & sea salt
Pinch of red pepper flakes and freshly cracked black pepper
instructions: Spoon the basil pesto directly into a cold non-stick skillet (the oil in the pesto replaces cooking oil) and warm over medium heat until sizzling.
Scatter a ring of crumbled feta cheese into the pesto, then crack the 2 eggs right into the center.
Cover with a lid and cook for 3–4 minutes until the feta edges turn lacy and golden-crispy and the egg whites are set with runny yolks.
Smash the avocado with lemon and salt onto toasted sourdough, slide the crispy pesto-feta eggs on top, and finish with chili flakes.
